courses.title: Introduction to Health Technologies
courses.description: This course provides a comprehensive survey of health technology programs, with a focus on the associated professions. It is designed to help students identify their personal strengths and areas for improvement as they relate to careers in the health technology field. Additionally, the course introduces foundational principles of human behavior, tailored to support students pursuing health technology professions.

courses.title: Clinical Hematology Laboratory
courses.description: This course introduces the various techniques and safety procedures used in the clinical hematology laboratory. Students will prepare and stain blood slides, perform microhematocrits, hemoglobin analysis, ESR, and Sickle Cell Screening. Correlating test results with disease states will be accomplished.
